cases.sentence: Копытами коней его истопчет он все ___ твои.
cases.explain: Улицы is the direct object of истопчет.
The verb предаст takes the dative of the indirect object.

cases.sentence: И столпы твоей ___ упадут на землю.
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession in the phrase 'pillars of might.'

cases.sentence: Копытами коней ___ истопчет он все улицы твои.
cases.explain: Его is the genitive possessive pronoun.

cases.sentence: Народ твой мечом предаст и ___ упадут на землю.
cases.explain: The genitive is used in the plural genitive possessive form.

cases.sentence: И ____ твоей силы упадут на землю.
cases.explain: Столпы is the subject of the verb упадут.
The verb упадут takes the accusative case with направление (на + accusative).
The genitive is used in instrumental expressions with possessive meaning.

reading.ru: Копытами коней его истопчет он все улицы твои.
reading.question: How will the streets of Tyre be destroyed?
options: Trampled by the hooves of the invader's horses
reading.correct: Trampled by the hooves of the invader's horses
reading.explain: The text states that the hooves of the horses will trample all the streets.

reading.question: What will be the fate of Tyre's people?
options: They will be delivered to the sword
They will be taken into slavery
They will escape to other lands
reading.correct: They will be delivered to the sword
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Your people he will deliver to the sword.'

reading.ru: И столпы твоей силы упадут на землю.
reading.question: What symbolizes Tyre's complete defeat?
options: The pillars of her might will fall to the ground
reading.correct: The pillars of her might will fall to the ground
reading.explain: The fall of the pillars of might symbolizes the total collapse of Tyre's power and authority.

reading.ru: Копытами коней его истопчет он все улицы твои и народ твой мечом предаст.
reading.question: What dual fate befalls Tyre in this verse?
options: Her streets are trampled and her people are slain
Her wealth is plundered and fortifications destroyed
Her people flee and enemies surround the harbor
Her leaders are captured and temples are destroyed
reading.correct: Her streets are trampled and her people are slain
reading.explain: The verse describes both the trampling of streets and the slaying of the people by the sword.

reading.ru: Столпы твоей силы упадут на землю.
reading.question: What is the ultimate consequence for Tyre?
options: Complete loss of power and authority
Transfer of power to another leader
Division of the city among allies
reading.correct: Complete loss of power and authority
reading.explain: The fall of the pillars of might indicates the total destruction of Tyre's power.

reading.ru: Копытами коней его истопчет он все улицы твои и народ твой мечом предаст и столпы твоей силы упадут на землю.
reading.question: What do all these judgments represent collectively?
options: Total military defeat and destruction of the city
reading.correct: Total military defeat and destruction of the city
reading.explain: The combination of physical destruction (trampled streets), human destruction (sword), and loss of power (fallen pillars) indicates total defeat.
